items.claim: Ian Machado Garry is very tall, standing at about 6'3.
items.quote: So, we've got Ian Machado Garry. He's very tall. I think he's about 6'3.

items.claim: Ian Machado Garry moves his feet well and avoids moving straight backwards, instead moving side to side and off at angles.
items.quote: the way that Ian Garry moves his feet, how well he does it... he never goes backwards straight. He's always like moving side to side.

items.claim: Ian Machado Garry maintains range well once he has his opponents moving backwards, especially against grapple-heavy fighters.
items.quote: once he's got his opponents going backwards, he keeps that range really well, but I think what he does well, especially when you're fighting someone who's grapple heavy, is he doesn't or he very rarely takes two or three steps backwards.

items.claim: Islam is a southpaw who efficiently walks his opponents down with straight shots without wasting energy.
items.quote: Islam, who's a southpaw, who's coming forward and he just kind of I'm not going to say he's a plodder cuz that makes him sound like he's bad, but he he's efficient with his footwork. He's not wasting any energy. He's just kind of like walking his opponent down and coming with the the straight shots.
